subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) It was held in Qatar. (b) Weather-wise, Qatar is a hot country. (c) It was the last edition where 32 teams participated. (d) Therefore, we are going to see 48 countries battling for the World Cup in 2026. (e) From the 2026 edition, 48 teams are likely to participate. (f) So, to avoid the hot weather, the tournament was scheduled in November and December. (g) A total of 32 teams participated in the tournament. (h) The 2022 FIFA World Cup, the greatest show on earth, was the 22nd edition of the Soccer World Cup. PartB : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: Rearranging 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 h a b f g c e d The 2022 FIFA World Cup, the greatest show on earth, was the 22nd edition of the Soccer World Cup. It was held in Qatar. Weather-wise, Qatar is a hot country. So, to avoid the hot weather, the tournament was scheduled in November and December. A total of 32 teams participated in the tournament. It was the last edition where 32 teams participated. From the 2026 edition, 48 teams are likely to participate. Therefore, we are going to see 48 countries battling for the World Cup in 2026. PartB : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 261

subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) She founded a home for the dying destitute and named it ‘Nimal Hriday’, meaning ‘pure heart’. (b) Mother Teresa died at the age of 87, on 5 September 1997. (c) These unloved and uncared people get an opportunity to die in an environment of kindness and love. (d) Mother Teresa was moved by the sight of the sick and dying on the streets of Kolkata. (e) She and her fellow nuns brought the dying people off the streets of Kolkata to this home. (f) They were lovingly looked after and cared for. (g) In their last hours, they get human and divine love, and can feel that they are also children of God. (h) Since then, men, women and children have been taken from the streets and carried to Nirmal Hriday. PartB : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: Rearranging 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 h a b f g c e d The 2022 FIFA World Cup, the greatest show on earth, was the 22nd edition of the Soccer World Cup. It was held in Qatar. Weather-wise, Qatar is a hot country. So, to avoid the hot weather, the tournament was scheduled in November and December. A total of 32 teams participated in the tournament. It was the last edition where 32 teams participated. From the 2026 edition, 48 teams are likely to participate. Therefore, we are going to see 48 countries battling for the World Cup in 2026.
